definitions: Recognise or ascertain what makes (someone or something) different.
Make (someone or something) different in the process of development or growth.
Distinguish between two or more things.
Become different in the process of development or growth.
examples: It's important to differentiate between the two terms.
The cells differentiate into various tissues.
We need to differentiate our product from the competition.
Children learn to differentiate colours at an early age.
